newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields rise, crown softens to dollar.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields rise, crown softens to dollar.

text.p: 0715 GMT - Swedish debt yields rose in early trade Friday in line with weaker European markets while the crown firmed against the mark but softened to the strengthening dollar.
Dealers said the crown softened to over 8.00 to the dollar mark in early trade and it could move back over this key level.
The market's key focus was U.S. data for July.
* Six month T-bill rate edges up one basis point to 4.29 pct
* 10-year bond yield rises three basis points to 6.41 pct
* Crown firms to 4.3295 to mark vs 4.3335 late Thursday
* Crown softens vs dollar to 7.9898 from 7.9684 Thursday
